summary: 23-year-old woman took a 20-foot fall on the lower section of the White Whale route on The Left Book formation, Lumpy Ridge, seriously injuring her lower leg; rangers climbed to her location, provided advanced life support, and lowered her to the base of the route, then evacuated her by belayed low-angle litter lowering and wheeled litter to a ground ambulance at Black Canyon meadow; thunderstorms with rain and lightning precluded helicopter use.
location: The Left Book formation, White Whale route, Lumpy Ridge, Rocky Mountain National Park
responding_agency: NPS Rocky Mountain National Park rangers
notes: NPS morning-report compendium entry dated 2013-08-01 (Thursday-verified); one of three simultaneous 2013-07-25 incidents.
